hook: 28,028 reviewers agree on this $30 container set

scenes.visual_prompt: Open 10-lb bulk rice bag slumped over, spilling slightly, pantry shelf in background
scenes.voiceover: Once a Costco rice bag is open, it slumps, and you have no idea how much is actually left until you're pouring air.

scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of a small moth near an unsealed bulk bag of oats
scenes.voiceover: It's also a pest problem. Reviewers on sealed-container listings keep mentioning pantry moths in opened bulk bags.

scenes.visual_prompt: Unboxing the Vtopmart 24-piece clear container set on a counter, lids lined up
scenes.voiceover: The Vtopmart 24-Piece Airtight Food Storage Container Set is $29.98 with a 4.7-star rating across 28,028 reviews — one of the highest review counts in kitchen storage on Amazon.

scenes.visual_prompt: Locking the four-sided lid on a container, then tipping the container sideways to show it stays sealed
scenes.on_screen_text: 4-sided locking lid stays sealed on its side
scenes.voiceover: That review count means the failure modes are documented, not guessed at. The locking lids hold even when a container is knocked on its side.

scenes.visual_prompt: Pouring rice, flour, oats, pasta, and sugar into separate clear labeled containers
scenes.on_screen_text: One set = one full bulk haul
scenes.voiceover: 24 pieces in different sizes decants an entire Costco run — rice, both flours, oats, pasta, sugar — with sizes left for coffee and dried beans.

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide shot of a shelf of matching clear containers, contents visible through the plastic
scenes.on_screen_text: See what you have, not guess
scenes.voiceover: This is the part a turntable can't fix — actually seeing what's left before you're out.

caption: $29.98 and 28,028 reviews for the container set that fixed my 'how much rice do I actually have left' problem. Clear sides, locking lids, holds sideways. Full pantry breakdown linked in bio.
